title: What Happened
speaker: NARRATOR
text: Eight months ago, under Saltmere Island, Vigor Biotech tested a virus they called V-7.

title: What Happened
speaker: NARRATOR
text: It was meant to make weak bodies strong. Old men. Sick men. People nobody would miss.

title: What Happened
speaker: NARRATOR
text: Subject seven was a dying fisherman. He did not stay dying.

title: What Happened
speaker: NARRATOR
text: Two of the staff were dead by morning. Vigor sealed the Annex and called it a flood.

title: What Happened
speaker: NARRATOR
text: What was left of the stock went into a container. The label said Medical Supplies.

title: What Happened
speaker: NARRATOR
text: Last night it came through Port Halvern. At 02:14, two dock workers opened it.

title: What Happened
speaker: NARRATOR
text: A cold mist came out. Breathe it, and it only takes the weak.

title: What Happened
speaker: NARRATOR
text: A bite takes anyone. And the strong come back stronger.

title: What Happened
speaker: NARRATOR
text: By dawn the port was gone. By breakfast it was walking into the city.

title: What Happened
speaker: LEON
text: None of that was on the news when I checked in.

title: Check-In
speaker: RUTH
text: Late one.

title: Check-In
speaker: LEON
text: Late flight. Cater, one night.

title: Check-In
speaker: RUTH
text: Three-oh-four. Elevator's out. Stairs are past the bar.

title: Check-In
speaker: LEON
text: Of course they are.

title: Check-In
speaker: RUTH
text: Breakfast is seven till ten.

title: Check-In
speaker: LEON
text: I'll be gone by seven.

title: Key Card Sleeve
speaker: Gullwing Hotel
text:
GULLWING HOTEL · HARBOR AVENUE · MARROW BAY
Room 304

Breakfast 07:00 to 10:00 in the Harbor Room.
The elevator is out of service. We apologise for the climb.

On the back, in biro: "Ice machine on 2 works. 3 doesn't. — R."

title: Voicemail, 22:51
speaker: Lena Ortiz
text:
"Cater, it's Ortiz, field office. Pruitt wants you at the nine o'clock. Don't be late, he counts.

[A pause, traffic behind her.]

And don't eat at the Gullwing. I've seen the kitchen. See you at nine."

title: Morning Bulletin
speaker: Channel 6
text:
[The TV wakes on its own at 07:00, an alarm somebody set and forgot.]

EMERGENCY BROADCAST — HARBOR DISTRICT
Residents between Harbor Avenue and the port are advised to remain indoors. Do not approach persons who appear unwell. Do not attempt to restrain them.

[The anchor is reading it off paper. Her hands are shaking. The ticker under her still runs the weather.]

title: The Window
speaker: LEON
text: That's not drunk.

title: The Knock
speaker: ORTIZ
text: Cater. Cater, it's Ortiz.

title: The Knock
speaker: LEON
text: You knock like one of them.

title: The Knock
speaker: ORTIZ
text: You answer the door like one. Put the bottle down.

title: The Knock
speaker: ORTIZ
text: You didn't pick up. Pruitt sent me. The port went dark at three and it's spreading this way.

title: The Knock
speaker: LEON
text: What is it?

title: The Knock
speaker: ORTIZ
text: Something off a Vigor container. Nobody's saying more than that on an open line.

title: The Knock
speaker: ORTIZ
text: Your sidearm. Thirty rounds. That's all I could carry.

title: The Knock
speaker: ORTIZ
text: And the knife. Quieter.

title: The Knock
speaker: LEON
text: They come for noise?

title: The Knock
speaker: ORTIZ
text: They wander toward it. They only come for you if they see you.

title: The Knock
speaker: ORTIZ
text: Break their line of sight and wait. They lose you. Whatever's in them chews up the part that remembers.

title: The Knock
speaker: ORTIZ
text: Bureau car, garage level two, bay fourteen. Key's yours. You drive, I shoot.

title: The Stairwell
speaker: ORTIZ
text: Too many. Go down, I'll pull them up.

title: The Stairwell
speaker: LEON
text: Ortiz —

title: The Stairwell
speaker: ORTIZ
text: Bay fourteen. Don't make me wait.

title: Night Desk Log
speaker: Ruth
text:
23:10. Cater, 304. Polite. Tired.

02:40. Ambulances on Harbor Ave. Lots.

03:55. Man from 309 says someone is trying his door. Told him it's the wind.

04:30. Phone lines busy. All of them.

05:10. A man came in off the street holding his arm. I put him in the back office with the first aid kit. He's quiet now. I'll check on him in a minute.

title: Note Under Door 309
text:
Folded hotel stationery, pushed halfway under the door from the inside:

DON'T OPEN FOR HIM.
HE SOUNDS LIKE FRANK.
HE ISN'T.

title: Garage Notice
speaker: Gullwing Hotel
text:
GUEST PARKING — LEVEL P2
Bays 1–20. Reserved: bays 12–16, Federal pool vehicles.

The ramp gate opens automatically for vehicles leaving. Please drive slowly. Pedestrians have right of way.

title: Bay Fourteen
speaker: ORTIZ
text: Drive.

title: Bay Fourteen
speaker: LEON
text: You took your time.

title: Bay Fourteen
speaker: ORTIZ
text: I took the long way. Kestrel Street, the field office. Don't stop for anyone.

title: The Drive
speaker: ORTIZ
text: Right out of the ramp. Stay off the pavement, they come out of the doorways.

title: The Drive
speaker: ORTIZ
text: Bus across the lane. Go round on the left.

title: The Drive
speaker: ORTIZ
text: Runners. Don't slow down. Slowing down is how they get on the car.

title: The Drive
speaker: LEON
text: They're fast.

title: The Drive
speaker: ORTIZ
text: The big ones are. The old ones can barely stand.

title: The Drive
speaker: ORTIZ
text: Left at the lights. There aren't any lights. Left anyway.

title: The Drive
speaker: ORTIZ
text: Kestrel Street. The gate with the sandbags. That's us.

title: The Field Office
speaker: PRUITT
text: Cater. You're late.

title: The Field Office
speaker: LEON
text: Traffic.

title: The Field Office
speaker: PRUITT
text: Port Halvern went dark at three. Vigor container. I'm taking the team in at noon.

title: The Field Office
speaker: LEON
text: I'm coming.

title: The Field Office
speaker: PRUITT
text: You're a liaison. You hold the phones. If we don't call by dark, you call the cavalry.

title: The Field Office
speaker: ORTIZ
text: We'll be back by dark, Cater. Keep the coffee on.

title: After the Briefing
speaker: NARRATOR
text: 13:00. Pruitt, Ortiz and Whitlock land at Port Halvern.

title: After the Briefing
speaker: NARRATOR
text: 17:40. Pruitt's last call: "Port police are here. Hale's people." Then nothing.

title: After the Briefing
speaker: NARRATOR
text: 22:00. Nobody answers the cavalry either. Leon hires a boat.
